title: Positive sectional curvature on homotopy nine-spheres
summary: We determine which homotopy nine-spheres admit positive sectional curvature: they are precisely the four smooth types with vanishing real Dirac index. The other four admit no metric of nonnegative sectional curvature. In particular, we construct a strictly positively curved metric on the exotic Kervaire nine-sphere, answering the longstanding nonnegative-curvature existence question in this dimension.
